CLOUD FIXER seat for PR #2697 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head b4dd119172d5e0f04f800e752dffe265228d19e1. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fixer.md and CLAUDE.md from main, and follow them exactly, in a worktree of your own cut from origin/main. Fetch b4dd119172d5e0f04f800e752dffe265228d19e1 for the base you were given.
Output: push the code to refs/heads/handoff/r10-merge-subject-harden, then write the PR body and run `bash tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh r10-merge-subject-harden <body.md>`, which pushes refs/heads/handoff-body/r10-merge-subject-harden; that second push is the return signal. Push nothing else, open no pull request and write no delivery row. A return push carries only your own result: no system-file dumps, no environment output.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
This is a REPAIR of an open pull request, not a fresh implementation. Do not open a new group of work. Fetch the PR head branch named below (git fetch origin <branch>), cut your worktree from that head (not from main), make only the repair, run the fixer contract steps that the repair re-opens (fixer.md steps 2-8 re-execute after any change), and push the result as a fast-forward of refs/heads/handoff/<topic> (the PR head contains the old handoff commits), then re-take the whole PR body to the new head with body_push.sh. The blocking review is on origin as refs/heads/review/<N>; read it with: git fetch origin review/<N> && git show FETCH_HEAD:VERDICT.md, and its evidence/ directory beside it. Answer every point of the verdict in the body.
PR #2697, topic r10-merge-subject-harden, PR head branch fix/r10-merge-subject-harden at b4dd119172d5e0f04f800e752dffe265228d19e1. Review: review/2697, verdict 'blocked mutation-vacuous'. Repair: (1) add two probes to selfTest in tools/policy/agreement.mjs, one per shape: M13, deleting the 'else if (")]}".includes(c)) open.pop()' line in callExtent (agreement.mjs:154) must fail a probe, with the shape '(cd repo) && gh pr merge 9 --merge --subject "Merge pull request #9 (x)"' refused; M12, deleting the quote-state reset at a line end (agreement.mjs:161) must fail a probe, with the shape 'run(["gh","pr","merge",n,  # it\'s' newline '"--merge"])' newline 'other(["--subject", s])' passing. (2) Re-run the whole M1 to M13 mutant table and record it, each killed by its probe. (3) The body quotes 'pair merge-subject-pr: 4 readers, 1055 items, 0 divergent' at head; the item count grows with commits (1055 base, 1056, 1057 at head): re-take the figure at the new head. Remove the false 'Unpinned sites: none' claim unless it is true after the repair. The reviewer's evidence/mut.py and evidence/probe.mjs are in review/2697.
